summary.text: Cindy Banyai is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 78, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Susan Frantz; there is no incumbent in the race.
Banyai holds a Ph.D. and works as an evaluator, and was the Democratic nominee for Florida's 19th Congressional District in 2020 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Banyai was born in Bay City, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2002, a master's degree from Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University in 2007 and a Ph.D. from the same university in 2010, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as an evaluator and in community development and organization development.
Banyai won the 2020 Democratic primary for U.S. House Florida District 19 and lost the general election to Byron Donalds, 38.7 percent to 61.3 percent.
She was the Democratic nominee again in 2022 and lost to incumbent Donalds, 32.0 percent to 68.0 percent.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mom and small business owner and listed water, health and community as her campaign messages.
Ballotpedia lists the Florida Education Association, the Democratic Environmental Caucus of Florida and the Florida AFL-CIO among her 2026 endorsements.
